reviews.title: Basic features behind a pay wall
reviews.text:
I’ve had this app for a year now, and when I got it you were able to use your own photo to trace over things. This was really helpful for projects and such where I’d have to transfer letters or designs I made onto big posters. 

I haven’t used it since maybe March-April of this year and now when I go back to check on it a few months later I find that you guys put the most basic feature behind a pay wall? You literally advertised it so you don’t have to pay to put your photos on there. 

My favorite part about this app is how different it is from the others. Instead of paying a crazy amount of money, I could easily use something with ads. That update really screwed this app over, and it shows you’ve become greedy. 

I’ve read other reviews and if you cared you’d remove that detail. If you need to, add a limit. Instead of absolutely no photos from your personal gallery, you can add a daily limit of let’s say 5 draws a day. 
 
That way it allows people to still use the app for the biggest reason people download it, while giving that wiggle room for them to buy premium if they choose.  

This really was a great app, so please take this into consideration.

reviews.title: Excellent Drawing App Ruined by Excessive Monetization
reviews.text:
I am extremely disappointed with this app’s business practices. What could have been a useful drawing platform is overshadowed by aggressive monetization and an apparent focus on revenue over user experience. Essential tools and features are locked behind costly paywalls, while users are repeatedly pressured to purchase subscriptions or upgrades. The pricing structure feels excessive and difficult to justify given the functionality provided.

Rather than fostering creativity and accessibility for artists, the app creates constant barriers designed to extract more money from its users. Many competing drawing applications offer comparable or superior features at a significantly more reasonable cost. The current approach gives the impression that profit is valued far more highly than customer satisfaction, product quality, or long-term user trust.

Unless substantial changes are made to the pricing model and overall user experience, I cannot recommend this app to other artists. The excessive focus on monetization has seriously diminished what could otherwise be a strong creative tool.
